description: Read a webhook inbox and captured requests. Provide filters, a limit or a cursor to page from newest to oldest.

cursor.description: Use nextCursor from the preceding page.

path.description: Exact path after the inbox URL, such as /billing. Omit the query string.

requestId.description: Read one capture with raw body and headers for local signature verification. Keep secrets in your local SDK or CLI.

token.description: Management or inspection token for anonymous resources. Omit for resources owned by your authenticated workspace.

name: inspect_webhook_inbox
